title: Passport validity for international travel
facts: There is no single worldwide rule that every country requires exactly six months of passport validity for every traveler.
Destination countries set their own passport-validity and blank-page requirements, and airlines can enforce documentation requirements before boarding.
U.S. travelers should check the State Department destination page for the specific country before departure.
A passport can be valid under U.S. issuance rules yet still have insufficient remaining validity for a particular destination.
